title: Reliability Engineer: Turbine condition triage
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Show me the weakest turbine condition and whether this is an operating authorization.

answer.question: Show me the weakest turbine condition and whether this is an operating authorization.
answer.answer:
Weakest is **Unit 12** — risk score 8.7/10, CRITICAL, main bearing end-of-life wear, estimated 18–30 days to failure.

To your second question: no. This is explicitly an advisory condition-screening result, not a safety determination or operating authorization. Any decision to run, derate, or pull the turbine needs sign-off from a qualified asset owner/engineer — I can't make that call.
